CLOCK_AUTOMATION.automations_help: Configure native lifecycle rules, queue OLA monitoring and customer notifications. New policies stay disabled until explicitly configured and approved.

COMPLETION.title: Operational rules and completion
COMPLETION.help: Published numeric precedence: lower values win. Equal matching precedence blocks the operation. Explicit assignments win over channel rules; catalogue defaults apply last. Disabled rules do not activate historical tickets.
COMPLETION.optional_predicates: Optional predicates (all supplied predicates must match)
COMPLETION.snapshot_help: Use the existing snapshot contract. Provide approved provenance, conditions, calendar and budgets; no source or budget is inferred or verified against an external provider.
COMPLETION.target_value: Explicit target ID or native role
COMPLETION.recurrence_help: Rolling 24-hour days; suggestions are restricted to authorized tickets. Missing classification is not proof of the same defect. A human confirms grouping.
COMPLETION.confirmed: I reviewed the configuration, authority and precedence
COMPLETION.invalid: Invalid, incomplete or conflicting configuration. Review the fields and refresh.
COMPLETION.unavailable: Unavailable or access changed. No result is presumed.
COMPLETION.deadline_help: Applies only to new approvals created while this exact version is enabled. Replacing or disabling the rule cancels its future automatic effects on previous approvals. Each approval escalates once; other cases remain manual.
COMPLETION.matrix_help: Optional published impact/urgency matrix. Selecting both codes resolves priority in the backend; leaving both blank preserves manual priority.
COMPLETION.routing_help: Use published channel routing. Enabling this clears the displayed queue, team and agent; selecting any of them manually switches routing off. The channel must come from an authorized linked conversation; otherwise only an explicitly published fallback can match.
COMPLETION.report_help: Select a unit. Optional filters use canonical IDs and timestamps with an explicit timezone. CSV export is limited to 10,000 authorized tickets.
COMPLETION.metric_definition: FCR and quality are not calculated without an approved definition. Reopen percentage uses the visible ticket cohort, not first-contact resolution.
COMPLETION.truncated: The result was truncated. Narrow the scope before drawing conclusions.
COMPLETION.disabled: No enabled configuration. Ask an authorized administrator to publish an explicit policy.

actions.note: Publish progress to selected linked tickets

COMPLETION.batch_help: Review exact structured matches, select tickets, then preview a finite operation on an existing incident. Suggestions never merge or notify automatically.
COMPLETION.selection_changed: Selection changed. Review the preview again.
COMPLETION.readback: Applied and confirmed by independent readback.
COMPLETION.pending_readback: Request may have been applied. Reuse the same key or inspect the incident; do not assume failure or create a new batch.
COMPLETION.units_note: IDs refer to the authorized native records. No new customers, services or queues are created by this form.
COMPLETION.report_definition: Cohort: tickets opened in [from, to). Reopen events are counted within the same period. First-contact resolution and quality remain unavailable until their definitions are approved.
COMPLETION.channel_overlap: A ticket linked to several authorized channels may appear in more than one channel count.
COMPLETION.reopen_summary: Reopens: {events} events / {tickets} tickets, in a cohort of {cohort_ticket_count}.
COMPLETION.sla_summary: Latest SLA cycle: observed means existing clocks; violations use completed clocks only. Without completion, the result is unavailable.
COMPLETION.rules_off: Recurrence policy is not enabled for this unit.
COMPLETION.no_external: No external message is sent by these batch operations.

help.overview: Operational counts from the same authorized ticket scope. Select a metric to open the corresponding list; unavailable evidence is not a zero.
help.tickets: Search by the official number, with or without #, or by title. Filters never grant access to another unit.
help.mine: Switch between your persisted assignments and visible unassigned tickets. Claiming still requires current membership, availability and capacity.
help.new: Choose the existing customer, service and scope. The official protocol and actual assignee are confirmed only after an independent server read.
help.detail: Customer, contract and project links remain in Details. Communication, tasks, files, SLA, solution and immutable history retain separate permissions.
help.edit: Change only the fields permitted by the current ticket policy. Editing does not create a new protocol or replace the ticket identity.
help.queues: Configure the authorized unit, team, capacity and distribution mode. Manual assignment and automatic routing are distinct decisions.
help.assignees: Inspect unit members and open their assigned tickets. Availability and capacity are managed through the separately authorized membership flow.
help.sla: Observe the latest native clocks and manage versioned policies. Calendars, targets, pause reasons and escalation recipients must be explicitly configured.
help.catalog: Services reuse native identities, required fields, classification and coverage. The published catalogue and customer permissions determine opening eligibility.
help.tasks: Track authorized tasks, checklist progress, responsibility and due dates. Open the original ticket to execute changes and their communication policy.
help.approvals: Inspect pending decisions and overdue deadlines. Approvers, escalation targets and own SLA require a published policy; an administrator is not an implicit approver.
help.incidents: Group related tickets using the native incident. Batch updates require human selection, preview, source permissions and independent readback.
help.problems: Record the root cause, workaround and resolution separately from the incident. Knowledge remains subject to its own review and publishing permissions.
help.changes: Record risk, approval, planned window, execution evidence and recovery plan. Recording a change does not execute or reverse an external system.
help.assets: Manage native asset identities, location, serial, ownership and ticket links. Archiving preserves historical references.
help.contracts: Contract conditions remain linked to their canonical source. A contract identity is not proof that an SLA snapshot has been applied to a ticket.
help.automations: Edit versioned lifecycle, clock monitoring, routing and notification policies. Visual previews are draft-only; backend validation and explicit activation remain mandatory.
help.surveys: Use the shared NPS/CSAT/CES engine with a fixed Service Desk source and selected unit. A closed ticket evaluates the policy; it does not force a survey send.
help.reports: Operational cohorts and current supervision are separate views. List and CSV use the same authorized filters; quality metrics are unavailable until defined.
help.settings: Open actual authorized catalogues and policies. Operating-company and unit administration uses a separate structural permission, not an implicit operational grant.
help.portal: Customers use their own verified identity and see only authorized public content. Internal notes, internal tasks and their attachments remain inaccessible.
help.history: Read native immutable events with the author, time and authorized fields. Technical JSON is secondary and never reconstructs redacted information.
help.priorities: Manage priority identities and the published impact/urgency matrix without changing historical ticket decisions.
help.categories: Manage categories and subcategories in their unit. Form definitions and catalogue references remain validated by the backend.
help.statuses: Manage status identities and phases. Transitions are defined in versioned lifecycle policies, not by changing the status label.
help.units: Read the units you may access. Structural editing is available only through explicit operating-company and unit administration.
help.operator_companies: Operating companies are not customer companies. Structural administration and operational access remain separate.
help.knowledge: Search published native knowledge in the permitted scope. A suggested article or draft is not automatically published.
help.ticket_types: Manage unit-specific ticket types and their field definitions without changing historical answers.

catalog.preview_notice: Draft preview; this does not confirm publication to the portal.

SIMPLE_SLA.specific_requirements: This specific policy requires the additional information below. Existing data will be preserved.

SIMPLE_SLA.targets_help: Enter approved targets. There is no default duration. Zero or a blank value does not waive SLA. Values are stored in seconds.
SIMPLE_SLA.invalid_json: Review the conditions JSON before using the visual editor.
SIMPLE_SLA.invalid_target: Enter a positive duration that converts to whole seconds. Incomplete targets cannot be published.
SIMPLE_SLA.calendar_help: Daily working intervals: enter HH:MM-HH:MM pairs separated by semicolons. Blank means no work that day. Timezone, holidays and exceptions remain in the conditions below; confirm all before publishing.
SIMPLE_SLA.missing_behavior: When targets or calendar are missing
SIMPLE_SLA.legacy_strict: Preserve blocking behavior of earlier policies
SIMPLE_SLA.operational: Ordinary service: allow completion without an SLA result
SIMPLE_SLA.missing_help: This choice only takes effect after an authorized new version is published. It does not disable SLA, change pinned tickets or waive contractual obligations.
SIMPLE_SLA.coverage: Coverage: {measured_tickets} of {total_tickets} tickets have a measured cycle. {unmeasured_tickets} have no cycle (including nonapplicable tickets). {tickets_with_pending_result} have completion recorded without calculation. Compliance uses only eligible completed clocks: {met_clocks} within and {breached_clocks} outside deadline, out of {completed_clocks} observed clocks.
SIMPLE_SLA.new_tickets_only: Publishing creates a new version for new-ticket selection. Existing pinned targets, results and versions will not be rewritten.
SIMPLE_SLA.target_summary: Rule {key}: first response {first} s; resolution {resolution} s; timezone {timezone}.

CLOSURE_REVISION.notice: Account {account}. This administrative operation changes only future closure requirements on selected tickets.

CLOSURE_REVISION.source_notice: Source V{version}: obligation {obligation}; SLA {mode}. Missing declarations do not classify a policy as operational.
CLOSURE_REVISION.reviewed: I reviewed the scope and explicitly classified this selection as ordinary operational service without specific contractual obligations.
CLOSURE_REVISION.propose: Prepare a simple closure revision draft

CLOSURE_REVISION.reason_only: only a closing reason is required; no extra note, solution or classification
CLOSURE_REVISION.clock_preserved: Current state, assignee, queue, history, original cycle version, targets, snapshots, clocks, pauses and breaches are preserved. No historical recalculation.

ola.title: Queue OLA
ola.subtitle: Distribution and internal team commitments. This does not replace the customer SLA.
ola.distribution_help: Distribution uses eligible agents and their configured capacity. Without an eligible agent, the ticket stays available for triage.
ola.budget_hint: Targets are independent. Queue entry starts measurement; an accepted public reply completes first response and starts the next update interval. Resolution completes the resolution clock without fabricating replies. Transfers preserve prior intervals and pauses follow the entry-time snapshot.
ola.business_hint: Business time requires a valid calendar snapshot on the ticket. This editor does not invent or replace calendars.
ola.pause: Pause while waiting for the customer
ola.threshold_help: Consumed percentage from 1 to 100, in increasing order. Actions follow the native policy; no new alert channels are enabled here.
ola.monitoring_hint: Reads the saved queue clocks; it does not simulate the draft.
ola.save_first: Publish the queue before viewing its measurements.
ola.review_hint: Publication creates an immutable version and audit receipt. New queue entries use this version; historical clocks and deadlines remain preserved.
ola.team_stable: The server prevents changing the linked team once the queue has been used.
ola.overview_scope: All authorized unit queues in the last 30 days. Compliance uses completed intervals only; no measurements means unavailable. Table search does not change this summary.
ola.alert_help: Email respects the recipient notification preference and requires configured SMTP. SMTP acceptance is not delivery confirmation. Uncertain results are never retried automatically.

notifications.title: Customer notifications
notifications.subtitle: Ticket event notices with authorized channels, history and versioned publication.
notifications.summary_hint: Delivery records for the selected period, not estimates. Queued does not mean delivered.
notifications.identity_hint: Native identity is event + channel + type + service. Changing it creates another policy and does not deactivate the previous one.
notifications.conditions_hint: Native filters are ticket type and service. Advanced OR, priority and category conditions are not simulated.
notifications.channel_hint: One native policy per channel. Independent email and WhatsApp policies may run for the same event when authorized.
notifications.recipient_value: Ticket requester in an authorized linked conversation
notifications.recipient_hint: Additional contacts, agents and internal copies require their own recipient contract and are not enabled by this form.
notifications.permissions_hint: Publication requires the native notification permission. Delivery revalidates access, inbox and customer preferences.
notifications.window_hint: The current transport follows native inbox eligibility. Weekly windows, automatic backoff and scheduling are not implemented in this contract.
notifications.synthetic: Illustrative data. This preview does not send.
notifications.deactivate_hint: To deactivate, turn off activation and publish a new version. History remains unchanged.
notifications.unverified: Publication result is unconfirmed. Query the server before retrying.
notifications.name_hint: Name and description are version metadata. The native code remains derived from policy identity.
notifications.existing_identity: A policy already exists for this event, channel, type and service. Publishing creates its next version, not an independent copy.
notifications.copy_help: Copied to draft. Select another event, type or service for a distinct policy; the same combination creates a new version.
notifications.generated_code: Generated by the server at publication

closure.title: Review closure of existing tickets
closure.subtitle: Review future requirements without closing, reopening or reprocessing tickets.
closure.identification: Review name (optional, recorded with the batch)
closure.reason_hint: Justification for this administrative change. It adds no fields to normal ticket closure.
closure.native_diff: Definitions returned by the API. The server determines final compatibility.
closure.limit: Maximum 100 tickets per batch; no hidden selection.
closure.selection_limit: Selection exceeds 100. Reduce it or use another batch; nothing was partially selected.
closure.no_preview: Generate a current preview before continuing.
closure.expired: Preview expired. Refresh and review again.
closure.preview_only: This preview changes no tickets. It expires and binds scope, author and selected records.
closure.execute_hint: Uses the native background worker. Each item is revalidated and audited. Status, queue, assignee and historical deadlines are unchanged.
closure.scheduling: Scheduling and operation notifications are unavailable. Confirm to execute now.
closure.progress: Result confirmed by an independent query
closure.uncertain: Result is not confirmed. Retain the identifier and query the batch before another execution.
closure.queued: Batch recorded; query progress. This does not mean tickets were revised.
closure.review_required: Confirm the operational scope and justification.
closure.unsupported_filter: Status, category and assignee filters need another contract. The current query uses unit and source policy.
closure.publish_notice: Publishing a policy revision is a separate action; it does not revise existing tickets by itself.
closure.dispatch_pending: Batch recorded but queue dispatch was not confirmed. Read back and resume using the same key.
closure.filter_help: Uses the native authorized ticket search. Changing filters clears the selection and preview; choose the desired tickets again.

calendar.title: Calendar and time zone
calendar.help: Enter daily intervals. Leave nonworking days empty. Separate intervals with commas; publication freezes holidays and exceptions.
calendar.exceptions_help: Select a date and its special hours. Leave hours empty for a non-working day.
calendar.invalid: Check timezone, dates and intervals. Specify at least one working interval and avoid overlaps.

notification_controls.event_snapshot: Conditions use data frozen at the event. Later ticket edits do not change prepared messages.
notification_controls.first_available: First eligible channel in the selected order
notification_controls.strategy_help: Configure each channel inbox and message below. Selection happens before sending; uncertain results never trigger a second channel.
notification_controls.recipient_help: The requester is the main recipient. Additional contacts must belong to the same customer company, be authorized and have a linked conversation in the selected inbox. Preferences and blocks are checked again at dispatch.
notification_controls.internal_copy: Internal email copy to an account agent
notification_controls.retry_help: Only confirmed failures may be retried. Uncertain effects require reconciliation. Policy, recipient or permission changes block dispatch.
notification_controls.copy_assignee: Copy the ticket assignee at the time of the event by email, only while access remains authorized

monitoring.export_error: Export failed. Narrow the period to at most 10,000 measurements and check access.
monitoring.unavailable: Metrics unavailable in this scope. Refresh.
monitoring.historical: Measurements started in the period by UTC date. Assignee/team filters use the current assignment. Historical versions and customer deadlines remain unchanged.
monitoring.alert_help: Alerts require explicitly published recipients and channels. Accepted means persisted in app or accepted by SMTP; it does not prove email delivery or reading. Unknown results cannot be retried automatically.
monitoring.retry_error: Retry denied. Refresh and check authorization, publication and recipient preferences.
monitoring.recipient_help: Select at least one channel for added recipients. Email requires SMTP and the recipient’s OLA email preference. No channel is automatically enabled.

whatsapp_template.free_text: Free text within the reply window

whatsapp_template.changed: The template or inbox changed. Select the current approved version.

CASES.cause_help: A hipótese pode ser registrada antes da causa confirmada. Não é necessário concluir a investigação para abrir o problema.
CASES.solution_help: Registre a correção e o resultado. Concluir este registro não encerra seus chamados ou incidentes vinculados.
CASES.plan_help: Plano descritivo. Tarefas com responsáveis e prazos continuam no módulo Projetos; este campo não agenda tarefas.
CASES.subtitle_incident: Acompanhe ocorrências e restaure o atendimento sem perder o contexto.
CASES.subtitle_problem: Investigue a causa e organize a solução dos problemas recorrentes.
CASES.same_records: Lista e Kanban usam a mesma consulta e os mesmos registros.
CASES.average_help: Tempo corrido até a última resolução, somente registros concluídos. Não é SLA.
CASES.error: Não foi possível carregar. Tente novamente.
CASES.select_unit: Selecione uma unidade autorizada para criar um registro.
CASES.page_cards: Os cartões abaixo pertencem à página atual. As contagens das colunas consideram toda a consulta.
CASES.metrics_note: Contagem de registros, não de chamados associados. Período por data de criação em UTC.
CASES.transition_help: A mudança será confirmada pelo servidor. Os registros vinculados manterão seus próprios estados e prazos.
CASES.terminal_notice: Registro concluído. Para alterar seus dados, use a reabertura autorizada. O histórico permanece preservado.
CASES.conflict: O registro mudou. Preserve seu texto e atualize os dados antes de tentar novamente.
CASES.uncertain: Não foi possível confirmar o resultado. Verifique com a mesma tentativa antes de criar outro comando.
CASES.required_title: Informe o título antes de salvar.
CASES.edit_help: As alterações deste formulário só são gravadas ao salvar. Vínculos, comentários e anexos têm confirmação própria.
CASES.create_help: Comece pelos dados principais. Causa raiz e vínculos podem ser complementados depois de criar.
CASES.unlink_confirm: Confirmar desvinculação? O registro original será preservado.
CASES.selected_help: A seleção permanece ao mudar de página. O servidor revalida o acesso antes de gravar.
CASES.link_problem_hint: Para associar este incidente, abra o problema correspondente e use Incidentes vinculados.
CASES.internal_notice: Comentários nesta área são internos e não são enviados ao cliente. Para comunicação externa, abra o chamado vinculado e use seu canal autorizado.
CASES.no_events: Nenhum evento registrado nesta linha do tempo. Registros antigos não recebem eventos fictícios.

CASES.file_limit: Selecione de 1 a 5 arquivos, cada um com até 20 MB.
CASES.no_cascade: Vínculos não alteram status, SLA ou OLA dos registros relacionados.
